notes.text: Acha bar Pinchas and Abaye give neighboring remarks.
Acha bar Pinchas reports in Rav Yosef’s name.
The proposed brotherhood and placement in Yehoshua ben Levi’s time remain qualified. Compare the Chanilai family register at 1547:1, which explicitly records Acha as not located.
Keep the bare Rav Acha in Abbahu’s saying and leave the proposed identification open. The local Abbahu dossier at 111:6 lists multiple Acha figures; this phrase also occurs in entry 295.
